patterns.note: Hero logo transformation: The initial oversized 'ONBOX' logo shrinks and transitions into a sticky header element upon scroll, simultaneously revealing a video hero below it.
Full-screen color transition: A solid deep navy blue background temporarily covers the entire viewport during a specific scroll depth, acting as a dramatic visual break or section transition.
Dynamic case study grid: Case studies are presented in a two-column grid with varying card sizes and aspect ratios, creating an asymmetrical and engaging layout.

Brutalist display typography: The site prominently features an extremely large, bold, and geometric sans-serif typeface for the main logo and key headings, creating a strong, almost brutalist visual impact.
High-contrast palette with a single vibrant accent: The design primarily uses black and white/light grey, punctuated by a bright orange for interactive elements and highlights.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a scroll-triggered transformation where a large, static text element scales down and repositions to become a sticky header, simultaneously revealing a full-width video background below it.
A full-viewport color overlay is triggered at a specific scroll point, providing a dramatic visual break before revealing the next content section.
Content sections, such as case study cards and article previews, appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display headings (~8-10x body) with clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate throughout, with very subtle rounding on some card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, especially in hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing elements to breathe.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the dynamic transformation of its massive, static 'ONBOX' logo from a hero element into a sticky header upon scroll, coupled with a dramatic full-screen color transition and a bold, almost brutalist typographic approach.
